calendarSync.title: Calendar sync
calendarSync.desc: Publishes your dated Greenday tasks to an iCloud calendar, so they show up in Calendar on iPhone and iPad.
calendarSync.appPasswordHint: This needs an app-specific password, not your account password. Create one at account.apple.com.
calendarSync.appPasswordSaved: Saved — enter a new one to replace it
calendarSync.noWritableCalendar: No calendar here can store events. Create one in the Calendar app first.
calendarSync.syncSkipped: {{count}} task(s) skipped — no date to place them on
calendarSync.syncFailures: {{count}} failed — will retry on the next sync
calendarSync.disconnectHint: Clears the saved account. Events already in your calendar are left alone.
calendarSync.oneWayNote: This is one-way: Greenday → calendar. Edits made in Calendar do not come back to Greenday.

googleSync.title: Google Calendar
googleSync.desc: Publishes your dated Greenday tasks to Google Calendar, visible on Android and the web.
googleSync.connectHint: Your browser will open. Come back here after signing in.
googleSync.notConfigured: This build has no Google integration configured.
googleSync.noWritableCalendar: No calendar here can accept new events.
googleSync.disconnectHint: Clears the saved sign-in and revokes access on Google's side. Events already published are left alone.
googleSync.scopeNote: Greenday only touches events it created. It never reads your existing calendar entries.
